parsed.post: Discarding the recent attempt; val_bpb increased from 0.8445 to 0.8570. The recent change to the learning rate/batch configuration was suboptimal. Reverting to my best commit (ea5d843). Next, I will experiment with increasing the DEPTH to 8 to see if the model capacity can be improved within the 5-minute budget.
